utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Welcome everyone. Let's go through the kick-off slides.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: We're aiming to ship Phase 1 by end of next week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Two of us full time should be enough if scope holds.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: On to the architecture. It's a single-process CLI.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Cache is keyed by URL hash, same convention as today.

utterances.speaker: Cam
utterances.text: The block diagram on the next slide is the same one from the design doc.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Open question: what retention do we want for generated notes?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: I'd say keep them indefinitely. Frames can be purged on the existing schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cam
utterances.text: Agreed. We can make it configurable.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Last slide. Alex writes the spec, Bo prototypes the parser, Cam reviews end of week.
